title: Fix quantity fields on Sales Return Order Archive
summary: Sales Return Order Archive pages now display return-receipt quantities instead of shipment quantities. Return quantity fields are added and bound to archive records, while shipment fields are hidden by default but remain for extensibility.
key_points: Added 'Return Qty. to Receive' and 'Return Qty. Received' fields to page 6628 bound to Sales Line Archive
Hid shipment-related fields ('Qty. to Ship' and 'Quantity Shipped') by default while preserving them for extensions
Added test coverage in SCMArchiveOrders codeunit for return quantity validation across archive snapshots
No changes to table schema, posting logic, or archive timing behavior
Archive controls are retained for page-extension compatibility and personalization
quote: The Sales Return Order Archive lines show ordinary shipment quantities instead of return-receipt quantities.
